name: linkedin-jobs-scraper
title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper & US Hiring Monitor
description: Monitor US hiring with public LinkedIn jobs, disclosed salaries, skills and workplace evidence. Compare saved observations for newly seen listings and known field changes. Export job datasets and JSON/CSV change reports. No login; no automatic paid-proxy fallback.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts. Number of events depends on memory (one per GB, minimum one).

job-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each job listing successfully scraped to the dataset.
